integrity: A complete symbolic all-parameter proof is supplied; the independent-in-method finite combinatorial checker covers the q=3,d=4 instance only. No external independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the explicit finite cubical-quotient Cayley graphs for q>=3 and d>=q+1. It does not address general graphs or higher homotopy, and the related companion manuscript remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Odd-primary fundamental groups hidden by mod-two cycle-length persistence
